paras.text: Computer and information technology (Computer and Information Technology)
paras.urdu: کمپیوٹر اور اطلاعاتی ٹیکنالوجی (Computer and Information Technology):
paras.pashto: کمپیوټر او معلوماتي ټکنالوژي (Computer and Information Technology)

paras.text: One extremely useful invention of the present age is the computer, because of which a great revolution has occurred in the information, commercial, social and political sectors. In this connection the technology of the internet (Internet), e-mail (E-mail) and other computer networks etc. is being used. The literal meaning of computer is: doing accounts, i.e. solving data (Data) of some kind and giving its result. E-mail means electronic mail, i.e. such mail as reaches its destination through signals of electricity. As it were, the written message which is sent from one computer to another computer is called e-mail. Through the internet one can phone any country, and its expenses too are very little; therefore, sitting in one’s office, information of every kind can be obtained from the whole world. Thus business people can contact traders of different countries through computer networks. In short, the computer can provide, sitting at home, the details of every kind required from the markets of the whole world. In this way, because of the computer and internet, the whole world has taken the form of one big city (Global Village), and through it you can become acquainted with the results of the academic and intellectual research of the whole world.

paras.text: Information technology (Information Technology)

paras.text: In the present age, in every sector and economic activity of an economy (Economy), progress has come to depend on information and communication technology (Information and Communication Technology: ICT). Nowadays, to make business, trade, foreign imports and exports and economic performance better and faster, it is necessary that the system and structure of telecom (Tele Com) be made modern and developed, because information technology has brought about a revolution in the economic world. Therefore the present twenty-first century is called the century of information technology (I.T. Century). From the progress and promotion of this technology individuals, businesses and different institutions and organisations have benefited greatly; as it were, at this time the whole world has taken the form of an information economy (Information Economy).

Computer and information technology (Computer and Information Technology)

One extremely useful invention of the present age is the computer, because of which a great revolution has occurred in the information, commercial, social and political sectors. In this connection the technology of the internet (Internet), e-mail (E-mail) and other computer networks etc. is being used. The literal meaning of computer is: doing accounts, i.e. solving data (Data) of some kind and giving its result. E-mail means electronic mail, i.e. such mail as reaches its destination through signals of electricity. As it were, the written message which is sent from one computer to another computer is called e-mail. Through the internet one can phone any country, and its expenses too are very little; therefore, sitting in one’s office, information of every kind can be obtained from the whole world. Thus business people can contact traders of different countries through computer networks. In short, the computer can provide, sitting at home, the details of every kind required from the markets of the whole world. In this way, because of the computer and internet, the whole world has taken the form of one big city (Global Village), and through it you can become acquainted with the results of the academic and intellectual research of the whole world.

Information technology (Information Technology)

In the present age, in every sector and economic activity of an economy (Economy), progress has come to depend on information and communication technology (Information and Communication Technology: ICT). Nowadays, to make business, trade, foreign imports and exports and economic performance better and faster, it is necessary that the system and structure of telecom (Tele Com) be made modern and developed, because information technology has brought about a revolution in the economic world. Therefore the present twenty-first century is called the century of information technology (I.T. Century). From the progress and promotion of this technology individuals, businesses and different institutions and organisations have benefited greatly; as it were, at this time the whole world has taken the form of an information economy (Information Economy).

By information technology is meant “such technology which obtains information, brings it into use for re-use, stores information, analyses it, transfers it, presents it again and expresses it.” It is defined thus:

"The technology employed in the capturing, inputting, storing, processing, transmitting, retrieving and displaying of information."

Role of means of communications in the economic prosperity of Pakistan (Role of Communication in Pakistan’s Prosperity)

In the previous pages it has been stated that means of communications play a very important role in the economic progress of any country; thus in Pakistan too these means have an important share in national prosperity (which has been stated at the beginning of this chapter); however, briefly they are mentioned here:

In Pakistan, in connection with electronic media (i.e. radio and TV), an institution was established in 2002 in this name: “Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority”, i.e. PEMRA (PEMRA). This institution issues licences for establishing radio, TV, cable TV and similar other media in the private sector. Thus by 2005, 23 licences were issued for FM (FM) radio broadcasts. کمپیوٹر اور اطلاعاتی ٹیکنالوجی (Computer and Information Technology):

دورِ حاضر کی ایک نہایت مفید ایجاد کمپیوٹر ہے، جس کے باعث اطلاعاتی، تجارتی، معاشرتی اور سیاسی شعبوں میں ایک عظیم انقلاب برپا ہو گیا ہے۔ اس سلسلہ میں انٹرنیٹ (Internet)، ای میل (E-mail) اور دیگر کمپیوٹر نیٹ ورکس وغیرہ کی ٹیکنالوجی استعمال ہو رہی ہے۔ کمپیوٹر کے لفظی معنی ہیں: حساب کتاب کرنا یعنی کسی قسم کے ڈیٹا (Data) کو حل کر کے اس کا رزلٹ دینا۔ ای میل کا مطلب ہے الیکٹرونکس میل یعنی ایسی ڈاک جو بجلی کے اشاروں سے اپنی منزل تک پہنچتی ہے۔ گویا ایک کمپیوٹر سے دوسرے کمپیوٹر پر جو تحریری پیغام بھیجا جاتا ہے اسے ای میل کہا جاتا ہے۔ انٹرنیٹ کے ذریعہ کسی بھی ملک میں فون کیا جا سکتا ہے اور اس کے اخراجات بھی بہت کم ہوتے ہیں، لہٰذا اپنے دفتر میں ہی بیٹھے دنیا بھر سے ہر قسم کی معلومات حاصل کی جا سکتی ہیں۔ چنانچہ کاروباری لوگ مختلف ملکوں کے تاجروں سے کمپیوٹر نیٹ ورک کے ذریعہ رابطہ کر سکتے ہیں۔ غرض کمپیوٹر ساری دنیا کی مارکیٹوں سے مطلوبہ ہر قسم کی تفصیل گھر بیٹھے مہیا کر سکتا ہے۔ یوں کمپیوٹر اور انٹرنیٹ کے باعث پوری دنیا ایک ہی بڑا شہر (Global Village) کی شکل اختیار کر گئی ہے اور اس کے ذریعہ آپ سارے جہاں کی علمی اور فکری تحقیق کے نتائج سے آگاہ ہو سکتے ہیں۔

اطلاعاتی ٹیکنالوجی (Information Technology)

عہدِ حاضر میں کسی معیشت (Economy) کے ہر شعبہ اور معاشی سرگرمیوں میں ترقی کا دارومدار اطلاعاتی و خبر رسانی کی ٹیکنالوجی (Information and Communication Technology: ICT) پر ہو گیا ہے۔ آج کل کاروبار، تجارت، بیرونِ ملک درآمد، برآمد اور معاشی کارکردگی کو بہتر اور تیز تر کرنے کے لیے ضروری ہے کہ ٹیلی کام (Tele Com) کے نظام اور ڈھانچے کو جدید تر اور ترقی یافتہ بنایا جائے کیونکہ اطلاعاتی ٹیکنالوجی نے معاشی دنیا میں ایک انقلاب برپا کر دیا ہے۔ اس لیے موجودہ اکیسویں صدی کو اطلاعاتی ٹیکنالوجی کی صدی (I.T. Century) کہا جاتا ہے۔ اس ٹیکنالوجی کی ترقی اور فروغ سے افراد، کاروبار اور مختلف اداروں و تنظیموں کو بہت فائدہ پہنچا ہے، گویا اس وقت پوری دنیا ایک اطلاعاتی معیشت (Information Economy) کی شکل اختیار کر چکی ہے۔

اطلاعاتی ٹیکنالوجی سے مراد ہے ”ایسی ٹیکنالوجی جو معلومات کو حاصل کرے، دوبارہ استعمال کے لیے کام میں لائے، معلومات کا ذخیرہ کرے، ان کا تجزیہ کرے، منتقل کرے، دوبارہ پیش کرے اور ان کا اظہار کرے۔“ اس کی تعریف یوں کی جاتی ہے:

"The technology employed in the capturing, inputting, storing, processing, transmitting, retrieving and displaying of information."

paras.pashto: 2. د دې وسایلو په برکت بازارونه پراخېږي، ځکه سوداګر لرې ناست د ټیلیفون له لارې مستقیم سوداګرۍ ترسره کولی شي. همدا لامل دی چې له کراچۍ تر پېښوره او له کوټې تر لاهوره د ډېرو توکو نرخونه تر ډېره حده یو شان دي، او هره شېبه د دې ډول سوداګریز ټیلیفونونه کېږي.

paras.text: 3. Through radio and television industrialists can advertise their manufactures and promote business.

paras.pashto: 4. د راډیو او ټلویزیون له لارې بزګرانو ته د کرنې ښې طریقې ویل کېدای شي.

paras.text: 5. Through radio and television programmes of education and recreation too can be provided. Thus school broadcast and university programmes add considerably to the knowledge of students. Music, dramas and features become a means of recreation for people.

Further, because of means of communications, mutual unity, political unity and harmony in civilisation are arising in the whole country, which is necessary for economic prosperity and progress.

paras.text: Importance of human labour (Significance of Labour)
paras.urdu: انسانی محنت کی اہمیت (Significance of Labour):
paras.pashto: د انساني کار اهمیت (Significance of Labour)

paras.text: In the production of wealth and things human labour has great importance. Land (Land) is considered a passive factor of production, but labour has been declared an efficient and active factor (Active Factor of Production). Nowadays countless things come into our use which could not even be imagined in old times. All these are the result of human labour and its physical or mental efforts. Cars, aircraft, televisions, air-conditioners, computers — the production of all of them is indebted to human labour. Man has established control over all natural resources, e.g. mountains, mines, forests and rivers. Most of the national income of big industrial countries, e.g. Britain, America and Japan, is produced with the help of industrial labourers. In agricultural countries, e.g. India, Pakistan and Bangladesh, production too is obtained by virtue of the day-and-night toil of cultivators; therefore the importance of labour in the production of things is very great.

Pakistan Broadcasting Corporation (PBC) has established twenty-five broadcasting houses, from where, besides other programmes, to keep the public informed about events, news is broadcast several times a day in 31 languages.

In the social, economic and political life of any country means of news-giving have great importance, e.g.:

1. The government can establish contact with the public, and through radio and TV can give them necessary instructions in emergency conditions. There is no better and more efficient method than this of conveying government instructions to the rural public spread over remote and wide areas.

2. By virtue of these means markets become wide, because business people, sitting far away, can settle deals directly through the telephone. This is why from Karachi to Peshawar and from Quetta to Lahore the rates of most goods are the same to a considerable extent, and business telephones of this nature keep happening every moment.

3. Through radio and television industrialists can advertise their manufactures and promote business.

4. Through radio and television cultivators can be told better methods of cultivation.

5. Through radio and television programmes of education and recreation too can be provided. Thus school broadcast and university programmes add considerably to the knowledge of students. Music, dramas and features become a means of recreation for people.

6. Besides this, in the sector of means of communications lakhs of individuals have got employment; an increase has occurred in the internal and external trade of the country; the speed of industrial progress has become fast; the production of the country is increasing. Further, because of means of communications, mutual unity, political unity and harmony in civilisation are arising in the whole country, which is necessary for economic prosperity and progress.

Importance of human labour (Significance of Labour)

In the production of wealth and things human labour has great importance. Land (Land) is considered a passive factor of production, but labour has been declared an efficient and active factor (Active Factor of Production). Nowadays countless things come into our use which could not even be imagined in old times. All these are the result of human labour and its physical or mental efforts. Cars, aircraft, televisions, air-conditioners, computers — the production of all of them is indebted to human labour. Man has established control over all natural resources, e.g. mountains, mines, forests and rivers. Most of the national income of big industrial countries, e.g. Britain, America and Japan, is produced with the help of industrial labourers. In agricultural countries, e.g. India, Pakistan and Bangladesh, production too is obtained by virtue of the day-and-night toil of cultivators; therefore the importance of labour in the production of things is very great.

Productivity (efficiency) of labour (Productivity (Efficiency) of Labour)

The ability and capacity to work of all labourers is not the same. Some are more efficient, hard-working and honest, and some less. Therefore in any country “the production of wealth” depends on one thing, how many workers there are, and on the second thing, how much the productive capacity and ability of the workers is.

5۔ ریڈیو اور ٹیلی ویژن کے ذریعے تعلیم اور تفریح کا پروگرام بھی مہیا کیا جا سکتا ہے۔ چنانچہ سکول براڈ کاسٹ اور یونیورسٹی پروگرام طلبہ و طالبات کے علم میں کافی اضافہ کرتے ہیں۔ موسیقی، ڈرامے اور فیچر لوگوں کی تفریحِ طبع کا ذریعہ بنتے ہیں۔

6۔ علاوہ ازیں ذرائع مواصلات کے شعبہ میں لاکھوں افراد کو روزگار ملا ہے، ملک کی اندرونی اور بیرونی تجارت میں اضافہ ہوا ہے، صنعتی ترقی کی رفتار تیز ہو گئی ہے، ملک کی پیداوار بڑھ رہی ہے۔ نیز ذرائع مواصلات کے باعث پورے ملک میں باہمی یگانگت، سیاسی اتحاد اور تہذیب و تمدن میں ہم آہنگی پیدا ہو رہی ہے جو معاشی خوشحالی اور ترقی کے لیے ضروری ہے۔

انسانی محنت کی اہمیت (Significance of Labour):

دولت اور چیزوں کی پیداوار میں انسانی محنت کو بڑی اہمیت حاصل ہے۔ زمین (Land) کو ایک غیر فعال عاملِ پیدائش تصور کیا جاتا ہے۔ لیکن محنت کو ایک مستعد اور فعال عامل (Active Factor of Production) قرار دیا گیا ہے۔ آج کل ہمارے استعمال میں بے شمار اشیاء آتی ہیں، جن کا زمانہ قدیم میں تصور بھی نہیں کیا جا سکتا تھا۔ یہ سب انسانی محنت اور اس کی جسمانی یا ذہنی کاوشوں کا نتیجہ ہیں۔ کاریں، ہوائی جہاز، ٹیلی ویژن، ائرکنڈیشنر، کمپیوٹر ان سب کی پیدائش انسانی محنت کی مرہونِ منت ہے۔ انسان نے تمام قدرتی ذرائع مثلاً پہاڑوں، کانوں، جنگلوں اور دریاؤں پر تسلط حاصل کر لیا ہے۔ بڑے بڑے صنعتی ممالک مثلاً برطانیہ، امریکہ اور جاپان کی قومی آمدنی کا بیشتر حصہ صنعتی مزدوروں کی مدد سے پیدا ہوتا ہے۔ زرعی ممالک مثلاً بھارت، پاکستان، بنگلہ دیش میں بھی پیداوار کاشت کاروں کی شبانہ روز مشقت کی بدولت حاصل کی جاتی ہے، لہٰذا پیدائشِ اشیاء میں محنت کی اہمیت بہت زیادہ ہے۔

محنت کی پیداواریت (استعداد) (Productivity (Efficiency) of Labour):

تمام مزدوروں کی قابلیت اور کام کرنے کی اہلیت ایک جیسی نہیں ہوتی۔ بعض زیادہ مستعد، محنتی اور دیانت دار ہوتے ہیں اور بعض کم۔ اس لیے کسی ملک میں ”پیدائشِ دولت“ کا دارومدار ایک تو اس بات پر ہے کہ وہاں کام کرنے والوں کی تعداد کیا ہے، اور دوسرا اس بات پر کہ کام کرنے والوں کی پیداواری استعداد اور صلاحیت کتنی ہے۔
